name: yandex-mail-dot-connector
description: Read-only Yandex Mail connector for dot through private Sites and Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deps: npm ci --prefix bridge --ignore-scripts && npm ci --prefix site --ignore-scripts
scripts.test: npm test --prefix bridge && npm test --prefix site && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix bridge && npm run build --prefix site
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:runtime --prefix bridge && npm run test:auth-runtime --prefix bridge
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:runtime
